verdict.rationale: Lium documents API keys whose scopes are fixed at creation, plus per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server. That covers the scoped-credential and spend-control half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows team or organization member management or role-based access. missing for 10: team member management, roles/RBAC, independent or hands-on corroboration of key scoping and budget enforcement.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: API keys with scopes and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server
Scopes limit what a key can do. They are set when you create the key and can't be changed later.
